name: Classic Datil Pepper Sauce
alt: Classic Datil Pepper Sauce label with dapper datil pepper gentleman
short: Bright, fruity datil heat in its most direct form.
desc: The datil pepper, straight up — fruity, bright, and genuinely hot. No smoke, just a balanced sauce built for eggs, tacos, grilled food, and everyday table use.
story: This is the datil in its most direct form. The gentleman on the label gives the flagship sauce a memorable old-Florida character: warm, confident, and a little unusual in the best way.
ingredients: Datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.

name: Smoked Datil Pepper Sauce
alt: Smoked Datil Pepper Sauce label with skull and datil pepper tree
short: Applewood smoke woven into the fruit of the datil pepper.
desc: Datil peppers spend time over applewood before the sauce ever comes together. The smoke deepens the fruit and brings a savory edge built for barbecue, chili, brisket, and anything from the grill.
story: The skull is tongue-in-cheek, not horror for horror’s sake. It signals smoke, depth, and the slow-burn personality of the sauce.
ingredients: Smoked datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.

name: Datil Pepper Jelly
alt: Datil Pepper Jelly label with dancing pepper couple
short: Sweet up front, datil warmth right behind it.
desc: A sweet-spicy expression of the Smoketree world. Serve it over cream cheese, add it to charcuterie, brush it onto pork, or use it as a finishing glaze.
story: The dancing pepper couple makes the jelly feel more approachable while still staying unmistakably Smoketree: ornate, warm, and label-driven.
